attested_fields.change_approval_process: All changes to cardholder-data-environment system components are raised as tickets, peer-reviewed, and require documented approval from the change-advisory board before deployment
attested_fields.rollback_procedure: Every change record documents a tested backout plan, and production deployments are gated on a validated rollback artifact that can be executed automatically
attested_fields.testing_requirement: Changes are functionally and security tested in a segregated non-production environment and must pass automated regression and security test suites before promotion
